0101.speaker: Child
0101.text: Will ya' buy me some sweets?

0102.speaker: Child
0102.text: You can buy them from the Merchant.

0106.speaker: Child
0106.text: I heard the Messenger telling a password to the Warrior. It was something like "...Pie".

0201.speaker: Merchant
0201.text: Hello customer! You wanna buy something?

0202.speaker: Merchant
0202.text: I have a few things to sell. Which one do you prefer?

0203.speaker: Merchant
0203.text: Okay, but do you have some free time? I would be happy if you could get me some unique ingredients.

0204.speaker: Merchant
0204.text: Okay it will be a gold coin. Choose one of your items from your inventory.

0205.speaker: Merchant
0205.text: Okay it will be a Priclys Feather. Choose one of your items from your inventory.

0206.speaker: Merchant
0206.text: So if you could get me a Blobfish I would be happy. Bye bye.

0207.speaker: Merchant
0207.text: Here are some sweets for ya! You've got some spare time?

0209.speaker: Merchant
0209.text: Here is the old scroll. You've got some spare time?

0211.speaker: Merchant
0211.text: At least you wanna buy something?

0212.speaker: Merchant
0212.text: Can you give them to me?

0213.speaker: Merchant
0213.text: Okay. Nice. I don't have much to share but I can tell you that at the troll's riddle the letters connect to numbers somehow as I heard.

0301.speaker: Guard
0301.text: Hello Boy. Are you interested in how this whole world works?

0302.speaker: Guard
0302.text: So let me tell you! This place is made out of different sections. We are in the Village Centre part. There are 3 other sections...

0303.speaker: Guard
0303.text: And do you know where you are?

0304.speaker: Guard
0304.text: The Grove, Bridge, and the Castle Entrance. At each section there are one or more people to talk with. You can get to each part easily but the castle is guarded by the Troll.

0305.speaker: Guard
0305.text: A troll. If you defeat it only then you can reach the entrance. But that's anything I could tell you. Have a fun time here!

0306.speaker: Guard
0306.text: Then I have nothing more to tell you.

0308.speaker: Guard
0308.text: Choose an item from your inventory.

0310.speaker: Guard
0310.text: Oh my medal! Thank you for giving it back. For this I'll give you the Mark of Goblins. Goblins will be friendlier if you show them. Now thank you again!!!

0401.speaker: Talking Tree
0401.text: Hello Human! What are you seeking here?

0402.speaker: Talking Tree
0402.text: I'm pleased you asked although I won't share...

0403.speaker: Talking Tree
0403.text: I know things about people. I can tell you things. Who are you interested in?

0404.speaker: Talking Tree
0404.text: I'll soon go asleep for like 20 mins maybe. After that we can talk again.

0405.speaker: Talking Tree
0405.text: That guy really has a sweet tooth. Also he hates running surprisingly! Now I'm going to sleep.

0406.speaker: Talking Tree
0406.text: That one is a mighty fighter and can only be defeated with the Sword of Koji. Now I shall rest.

0407.speaker: Talking Tree
0407.text: At least I can give you this magic branch that will help you on your mission. I insist. Now I'm going to rest.

0409.speaker: Talking Tree
0409.text: Hello again. I remember you were so surprised to see a wonderful tree like me. Because of that I give you the Horn of Trees. If you blow it I will wake up from my dream. And now how can I help you?

0410.speaker: Talking Tree
0410.text: Hello again. I can tell you things about some people.

0501.speaker: Hunter
0501.text: Greetings traveler! I'm on a hurry but I can give you a few minutes.

0502.speaker: Hunter
0502.text: I'm always in a hurry hunting for the unique species that are attracted to this grove.

0503.speaker: Hunter
0503.text: I am the hunter who hunts for the species hidden in this special grove!

0504.speaker: Hunter
0504.text: I don't know, but I swear there is something magical hidden in this grove. You should check the trees! And now I gotta go!

0505.speaker: Hunter
0505.text: Yes, but I might not know the answer.

buttons.label: How to get in to the castle?

0506.speaker: Hunter
0506.text: Hello again! I'm chasing a Pina Coala, I've got no time, but I saw something shiny between the fountains stones.

0507.speaker: Hunter
0507.text: Hello adventurer! I'm back from my hunt and now I can answer a few questions, but first...

0508.speaker: Hunter
0508.text: The hunter is nowhere to be seen.

0509.speaker: Hunter
0509.text: Do you see the little footprints? That creature is better at hiding than anything else I've ever seen before. He might be hiding in one of the bushy places where I can't fit in!

0510.speaker: Hunter
0510.text: But now let's see your questions.

0511.speaker: Hunter
0511.text: Well, at the bridge I saw strange carvings in the stone, but nothing else.

0512.speaker: Hunter
0512.text: Well have you seen the city guard? He is a friend of mine. He will tell you things about this little empire!

0513.speaker: Hunter
0513.text: Also could you please give this golden medal to the guard? He might give you something in exchange.

0514.speaker: Hunter
0514.text: Okay and... Do you hear those wolves? This is the night of the blood moon, I shall go hunting, this is the time for the best prey!

0601.speaker: Goblin
0601.text: Hello who are you? I'm the goblin living in the forest. I'm glad we met.

0602.speaker: Goblin
0602.text: Hello come with me! Let me show you my collection!

0603.speaker: Goblin
0603.text: Yesss. Definitely. I have a collection of rare items I'm pretty proud of!

0604.speaker: Goblin
0604.text: Oh you've got the mark of goblins. Let me gift you something my friend!

0605.speaker: Goblin
0605.text: Hi again! May I show you my collection this time?

0606.speaker: Goblin
0606.text: Here! Look what I've collected! If you want one just say!

0607.speaker: Goblin
0607.text: This is a Gold Coin I found in the forest. I would trade it for something from a rare animal like a bird.

buttons.label: Let me see the other items

0608.speaker: Goblin
0608.text: Here take this Gold Coin I found. This treasure looks especially good.

0609.speaker: Goblin
0609.text: This ruby sword was down in the bottom of the river. I saw its ruby and I had to have it. If you want it give me some other gem.

buttons.label: Let me see the other items

0610.speaker: Goblin
0610.text: Hey I've found this powder in a leather sack and I thought it was really strange so I kept it. I would trade it for a shinier jewel.

buttons.label: Let me see the other items

0612.speaker: Goblin
0612.text: Here is the strange powder. I like shinies, human, like dust... It's good for goblins!

0613.speaker: Goblin
0613.text: Here is the ruby sword. I like crystal shard better: It's shinier.

0614.speaker: Goblin
0614.text: Here is the gold coin. Feather might be trash for humans but treasure for goblins!

0616.speaker: Goblin
0616.text: Can I give you one more gift for being my great trader mate? Here is the Staff of Goblins. This means you are the great friend of goblins.

0617.speaker: Goblin
0617.text: Now I'm leaving because all treasure here is inside my pockets!

0618.speaker: Goblin
0618.text: The goblin has left with all their valuables.

0703.speaker: Troll
0703.text: You can no cross if no riddle solve. I tell you riddle.

0705.speaker: Troll
0705.text: First 5 letter: O, T, T, F, F, S... Whats next 2?

0706.speaker: Troll
0706.text: You smart! Here bridge key. Now go!

0707.speaker: Troll
0707.text: The Troll sits at the edge of the bridge and does not care about you.

0801.speaker: Fisherman
0801.text: Hello! What are you doing at the river?

0802.speaker: Fisherman
0802.text: Well you walk a few meters it's right there. Turn right from here but before with the troll also could you help me with something?

0803.speaker: Fisherman
0803.text: You should go to the river. The troll is stopping you but his riddle is not that hard.

0804.speaker: Fisherman
0804.text: Here is a fishing rod. Take it and throw it in. Try catching great salmon. They usually come after 20-25 seconds.

0805.speaker: Fisherman
0805.text: Then I'll see you next time.

0806.speaker: Fisherman
0806.text: I'm fishing patiently trying catching a great salmon but I can only find small fish in this muddy river.

0807.speaker: Fisherman
0807.text: Do you have the great salmon?

0809.speaker: Fisherman
0809.text: I can do nothing with. Try again. Can you help me in catching the prey?

0812.speaker: Fisherman
0812.text: In return I can tell you that the Troll's "o" means "one".

0814.speaker: Fisherman
0814.text: Bye bye. Now do not disturb me again in fishing!

0815.speaker: Fisherman
0815.text: Well... if you could give this to the messenger... and return of a favor please give these fish to him. He might tell you something.

0816.speaker: Fisherman
0816.text: The fisherman waves at you and then puts the finger in front of his mouth "shh". You can't talk to him right now.

0901.speaker: Messenger
0901.text: Hi I am the messenger. I'm always walking around delivering messages to various people.

0902.speaker: Messenger
0902.text: Hey no I hate running. I would never run. Now if you have something important...

0904.speaker: Messenger
0904.text: Well... I lost - let me count - three messages went lost when I was at the bridge's Castle side end. I dropped them. If you could bring those back I'd be happy.

0905.speaker: Messenger
0905.text: Oh thank you!!! In return I can tell you the first part of the password.

0907.speaker: Messenger
0907.text: Ooh the Fisherman sent me these fish? Nice. In return I'll tell you: if you ever find strange words on paper you should use a decoder powder which is just a gray powder. Now I gotta go.

0908.speaker: Messenger
0908.text: Please give them to me. I really need them.

0909.speaker: Messenger
0909.text: Then why did you come back? I'm in hurry. Only come back when you have those letters.

0910.speaker: Messenger
0910.text: Hello do you want to help me in something?

0911.speaker: Messenger
0911.text: The first part of the password is "Apple", now I gotta go!

0913.speaker: Messenger
0913.text: That is not what I need.

1001.speaker: Warrior
1001.text: Hello! If you wanna get inside, you have to know the password!

buttons.label: I don't know, but I show you something

1004.speaker: Warrior
1004.text: No you can't get inside with that.

buttons.label: I wanna give it to you

1007.speaker: Warrior
1007.text: Well... that's correct! You may go in.

1008.speaker: Warrior
1008.text: Well... that's incorrect. You must stay out!

1009.speaker: Warrior
1009.text: Let's go!! Nothing happens. A dinosaur jumps out of your hand and two strikes it defeats the guard.

1010.speaker: Warrior
1010.text: You swing it. Little rainbow sparkles, but nothing else.

buttons.label: Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha...
I wanna give it to you

1103.speaker: Sweets
1103.text:
You actually ate them. Now you lost a valuable resource...

Just great...

1201.speaker: Old Scroll
1201.text: Its just an old scroll folded up!

1202.speaker: Old Scroll
1202.text: Its paper looks very old, and its a little bit dirty.

1203.speaker: Old Scroll
1203.text:
Ypu unfold it and find a strange thing written on it:

Rcuuygtf:Crrmgrkg

1204.speaker: Old Scroll
1204.text: You start babbling but nothing extraordinary happens wxpect you look like you lost your mind.

1207.speaker: Old Scroll
1207.text:
The words shimmer and the magic powder turns into dust and the evaporates under it you find new words.

Password:Applepie

1301.speaker: Magic Branch
1301.text: This is a branch you've got from a talking tree.

1302.speaker: Magic Branch
1302.text: Rainbow glitters appear but nothing else changes.

1401.speaker: Horn of Trees
1401.text: This strange horn You've got from tree. It looks like an instrument.

1402.speaker: Horn of Trees
1402.text: When you blow it you hear a voice of dried leaf rustling, and the tree speaks to you.

1501.speaker: Bridge Key
1501.text: A silver Key. You can open the bridge with it.

1502.speaker: Bridge Key
1502.text: Now the bridge is open and you can access the Castle Entrance area.

1601.speaker: Golden Medal
1601.text: A golden coin attached to a silk string. It was given to you by the hunter to give this to his friend the Guard, in the means of friendship.

1701.speaker: Mark of Goblins
1701.text: A silver coin with a goblin face carved into it. The guard believes it impresses goblins.

1801.speaker: Priclys Feather
1801.text: A yellowish-brown feather with white spots, probably from a strange creature.

1802.speaker: Priclys Feather
1802.text: You hear the voices of birds flapping their wings, and then it fades away.

1901.speaker: Strange Powder
1901.text: This powder is really strange. You could try rubbing it into something because it looks magical.

1903.speaker: Strange Powder
1903.text: When you rub it into the old paper, it shimmers and the new text appears. Password:”apple pie”. You got the password to something.

2001.speaker: Gold Coin
2001.text: A golden coin Found by the goblin, can be used for transactional. purpose.

2101.speaker: Ruby Sword / Sword of Koji
2101.text: The blade looks very ancient, very unique. You are glad to have it from the goblin.

2102.speaker: Ruby Sword / Sword of Koji
2102.text: When you hold it like a sword fighter, you feel a great strength in your veins. You try a few complicated moves. They are super easy. You became a very good fighter.

2103.speaker: Ruby Sword / Sword of Koji
2103.text: When you throw it, it comes back to you like a boomerang. This looks like a magical weapon.

2201.speaker: Staff of Goblins
2201.text: This wooden and gold staff you got from a goblin is the symbol of friendship.

2202.speaker: Staff of Goblins
2202.text: You stomp it. You hear a fading goblin laugh, and then silence.

2301.speaker: Fishing Rod
2301.text: Just a fishing rod with a small bobber.

2302.speaker: Fishing Rod
2302.text: You throw it in and wait two-three seconds.

2310.speaker: Fishing Rod
2310.text: Nothing. You caught nothing. Now, you go away.

2311.speaker: Fishing Rod
2311.text: You struggle with the pull in, and at the end of the road, there is a blobfish.

2312.speaker: Fishing Rod
2312.text: You start pulling it in, you struggle, and then ta-da, there is a large salmon

2401.speaker: Crystal Shard
2401.text: A blue shard, when you put it towards the light, it emits a rainbow.

2501.speaker: Blobfish
2501.text: It looks just like a deflated ball.

2502.speaker: Blobfish
2502.text: you struggle and fail for a long time. Then you give up.

2601.speaker: Silver Ring
2601.text: A beautiful shining ring you found at the river.

2602.speaker: Silver Ring
2602.text: You put it on your finger, and it looks good with its silvery shining.

2701.speaker: Bundle of Letters
2701.text: A bundle of letters you found at the bridge dropped by someone.

2801.speaker: Scroll with Password
2801.text: It's just the old scroll, but decoded.

2802.speaker: Scroll with Password
2802.text: The words On the paper read, “password: applepie.” Though, where should you use it?

2901.speaker: Old Boots
2901.text: Just a pair of worn leather boots. Still dripping water.

2902.speaker: Old Boots
2902.text: You put it on but they are so wet and uncomfortable you immediately take it off.

3001.speaker: Great Salmon
3001.text: It's just a large fish. Wait…its still alive!

3101.speaker: Fish
3101.text: These are just fish in a bag.

compilerNotes: PASSWORD_INPUT from the source spreadsheet is normalized to DROPDOWN_CHOICE.
Item dialogues use the same page/button/action/condition shape as NPC encounters.
Item dialogue buttons use next='HOME' when the design says the player returns Home.
Blobfish replaces Pufferfish everywhere per the current item canon.
Message Paper is normalized to Bundle of Letters per the current item canon.
Staff of Goblin is normalized to Staff of Goblins per the current item canon.
Magic Branch on Warrior page 1002 links to the already-existing failed rainbow-sparkle page 1010.
UNLOCK_AREA is represented for Bridge Key and requires an app action handler.
specialMechanics records Sweets five-attempt eating, Silver Ring one-time Wear, and one-time Fishing Rod catches.
Horn of Trees intentionally links to NPC page 0410.
compilerWarnings: The app must read gameData.items when an inventory item is tapped.
The app must understand the HOME next target for item dialogue buttons.
UNLOCK_AREA is a new action type and must be implemented for Bridge Key to unlock the Castle Entrance.
specialMechanics must be implemented to enforce the exact Sweets, Silver Ring, and Fishing Rod rules.
Item dialogue navigation must allow Horn of Trees to open NPC page 0410.
